workflow.processing.checkPostPassword: Check the original post for the password and continue
workflow.processing.inputFiles.title: Files for this step
workflow.processing.inputFiles.missing: This step has no identifiable input file list.
workflow.extraction.layout.label: Extract to
workflow.extraction.layout.archiveDirect: A subdirectory named after the archive
workflow.extraction.layout.hint: Both layouts preserve the folders inside the archive. If files would collide, processing waits for review.
workflow.processing.editor.title: File processing steps
workflow.processing.editor.hint: Add the steps needed for the current input files, in order. This edits the plan for server validation; it does not infer instructions or add extraction layers automatically.
workflow.processing.editor.advancedRequi: This plan contains a structure the form cannot represent or incomplete JSON. Edit it in advanced mode; existing data is preserved.
workflow.processing.editor.initialInput: Current input files (selected artifact or download)
workflow.processing.editor.multipleInput: This step combines multiple inputs. Use advanced JSON to change their relationships; editing other fields preserves these references.
workflow.processing.editor.selectorHint: Leave empty for files from this input, or enter an exact file name or wildcard such as *.zip.
workflow.processing.editor.passwordHint: Leave empty to use the source's existing archive password, or supply a different password here.
Specify an encoding only for garbled filenames when the original encoding is known. Manual selection currently supports only unencrypted, single-volume ZIPs without a prefix. Keep Automatic for encrypted, split or image-prefixed ZIPs.
workflow.processing.editor.extensionHint: Include the leading dot, such as .zip or .7z. This changes the name, not the file format.
workflow.processing.editor.directoryHint: A subdirectory relative to this step's output, such as videos. Delivery settings control the final destination.
workflow.processing.editor.referenced: Later steps use this result. Change their inputs before removing this step.
workflow.processing.editor.chooseSourceD: Choose a folder from the input files
workflow.processing.editor.sourceDirecto: Enter the exact relative directory within the input artifact, such as outer/photos. A nonempty directory is required; wildcards and parent traversal are not accepted.
workflow.processing.editor.rebaseDirecto: Enter a directory relative to this step’s output; empty or . means the output root. The inner directory structure and other files are retained. Name collisions stop processing.
workflow.processing.archiveOpenMode.hint: Use only when the original instructions explicitly require 7-Zip # mode, with one exact input filename. This extracts container members; add a separate step to unpack an archive inside.
workflow.processing.archiveOpenMode.memb: Enter the exact member named by the instructions, such as 2.zip. Wildcards are unsupported. Leave empty to retain all fragments. Extracting one member keeps the original container in the workspace and does not authorize its automatic cleanup.
Select only when a known password uses a confirmed incompatible encoding. Independent of filename encoding; supports single-volume ZIPs without a prefix. Does not guess passwords or try other encodings.
An explicit password encoding requires the ZIP compatibility engine. Install it here using your configured base Python environment.
